Identify rows where a feature lies fully within a split region

Source: R/process_gtf.R
dot-rows_within_region.Rd

Applies the matching rule used by process_gtf(). A feature start, end should be fully inside a region: RegionStart, RegionEnd: start >= RegionStart end <= RegionEnd

Usage

.rows_within_region(df)

Arguments

df

Data frame containing start, end, RegionStart, RegionEnd.

Value

Logical vector of length nrow(df).

Details

Retained for reference/tests; the main pipeline now enforces this rule directly inside .match_features_to_regions() without a full cross join.
